title: The Ten Commandments
reflectionQuestion: God gave his people good ways to live together, because he loved them. What is one kind way you can treat the people you love?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Moses, secondary/short-only). Per Adam (2026-06-18): the emotional center is 'God gave his people GOOD WAYS TO LIVE TOGETHER' (warm/relational), NOT 'rules' -- and DO NOT let it become a list. So only a few commandments are voiced, each framed warmly (love God, a rest day, honor parents, tell the truth, don't take, be kind), with the 'loving path through a forest' image carrying the meaning. Sinai wonder (cloud, thunder, God near) provides awe. KEEP 'God' -- NOT a Yahweh story; we just used Yahweh at Carmel (1842), don't repeat the covenant name so soon and the name is not this story's point. 4th Moses story (1810/1811/1813) but a distinct scene (Sinai/the good ways). Indelible image = Moses carrying God's good words down the cloud-wrapped mountain. Lands on 'one big family -- loving God, and loving each other'. VOICE_DEBORAH_WISE (authoritative yet kind female) -- leadership/law register, warm not stern.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
